name: AUSDOM E9 Over-Ear Wireless Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headphones
description: Selling an authentic pair of AUSDOM E9 Wireless Active Noise Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones. Verified by the official global MIC technical certification sticker (ID: 018-180085) located on the inner structural headband slider. These sleek black headphones feature an advanced self-schemed ANC processor that effectively cancels out low-frequency ambient drone, making them perfect for study sessions, office environments, or noisy flights. Equipped with large 40mm aperture drivers, they deliver crisp treble, clear vocals, and deep bass performance. The cloud-soft memory protein leather ear cushions and adjustable multi-angle swivel headband offer an incredibly comfortable, fatigue-free fit for extended wear. Battery life is fantastic, offering up to 60 hours of wireless music playback. Minor superficial scuffs are present on the matte plastic hinge casing from gentle use, but the headphones function flawlessly. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a cat, though the entire unit has been thoroughly vacuumed, wiped down, and sanitized.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and ready to instantly pair with your smartphone, laptop, or tablet. Since this is a personal electronic accessory item, it does NOT come with an additional fabric or cloth storage bag. Please bring a small pouch, pocket, or backpack for local pickup transport. Rest assured that although the item comes from a cat-friendly home, it has been meticulously sanitized and double-wiped with alcohol pads prior to listing. Pricing tiers are kept highly compact and smooth!
meta_description: Great condition AUSDOM E9 wireless active noise cancelling headphones (MIC ID: 018-180085). 60-hour battery, deep bass, fully sanitized for custom listing.
name_zh: AUSDOM 澳斯盾 E9 无线主动降噪蓝牙罩耳式头戴耳机
